values.meaning: First champion damage instance from the shielded direction is reduced by 100%
values.quote: The first instance of damage dealt by a {{tip|champion}} from this direction is reduced by 100%.
values.binNote: No bin row stores a 100% figure for this one-time full block; the sheet only has ShieldFacingDRAmount (the partial facing DR) and no separate data value for the champion first-hit full-block mechanic, so this number is wiki-only.

mechanics.claim: Braum's shield intercepts all incoming hostile projectiles from the target direction, destroying them, in addition to the damage reduction.
mechanics.quote: creating a barrier in front of him that intercepts all incoming hostile {{tip|projectiles}} and reduces the damage '''Braum''' takes through it from enemies in the target direction

mechanics.claim: The 100% damage reduction can block multiple instances of damage dealt at the same time, not just one attack.
mechanics.quote: ''Unbreakable's'' full damage reduction can block multiple instances of damage if they're dealt at the same time.

mechanics.claim: For damage over time, the reduction applies to only a single tick, and the flat damage reduction applies to each qualifying instance separately.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Damage over time}} is calculated per tick but the full damage reduction will still only apply to a single tick.

mechanics.claim: The one-time full damage reduction is not consumed by pure true damage sources.
mechanics.quote: The one-time-use full damage reduction will not be consumed if the damage source is nothing but {{tip|true damage}}.

mechanics.claim: While active, Braum gains bonus movement speed and ghosting.
The ability does not affect turrets.
Cooldown starts after the shield's effect ends, not on cast.
